question: Estimate monthly soft drink sales (Coca-Cola + Pepsi + Thums Up etc.) in a Tier 1 city like Hyderabad.
idealClarificationQuestions: Carbonated soft drinks (CSDs) only? Yes — exclude juice, water.
All formats: PET bottles + cans + fountain drinks at QSRs? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Round: ~9 million litres / ~₹45 Cr monthly Hyderabad CSD market.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: - Coca-Cola brands (Coke, Thums Up, Sprite, Limca)

calculationFlow: Per-capita CSD consumption India avg: ~6 L/year. Hyderabad (warm + Tier 1): ~9 L/year.
Annual Hyderabad CSD consumption: 12M × 9 L = ~108 million litres/year.
- Coca-Cola brands (Coke, Thums Up, Sprite, Limca): ~52% market share = ₹23 Cr.
Round: ~9 million litres / ~₹45 Cr monthly Hyderabad CSD market.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: ~9 million litres / ~₹45 Cr monthly Hyderabad CSD market.
